contribution.position: On reliability grounds the change is not yet demonstrated: the unit and perf results are green (412 passed, 0 failed, 87% coverage; p99 within budget), but the dual-write soak test in the runbook is still TODO and has never been run, and the two sev2 incidents last quarter were both retry storms — exactly the failure mode an unsoaked dual-write path can amplify. The reliability question should stay open until the soak test is executed and retry behavior under failure injection is observed.
